name: How long does it take to install a kitchen faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a kitchen faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a kitchen faucet installation can vary depending on factors such as the complexity of the faucet, the condition of existing plumbing, and ease of access under the sink. A straightforward replacement might take 1-3 hours. However, if modifications to the sink or plumbing are needed, or if there are seized connections, it could take longer. Hometelligent Inc. will provide an estimated timeframe after an initial assessment.
